description: This PHP file defines the JobCategoryService class, which manages operations related to job categories within the OrangeHRM system, including fetching, saving, deleting, and normalizing job category data.

classes.name: JobCategoryService
classes.description: Service class responsible for business logic related to job categories, acting as an intermediary between the controllers and DAO layer, and utilizing normalization traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the JobCategoryDao instance used for data operations.

methods.name: getJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO instance used internally for job category data access.

methods.name: setJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance, allowing for dependency injection or mocking in tests.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job categories with optional sorting, pagination, and counting.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Fetches a single job category by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Saves or updates a job category entity.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes multiple job categories identified by their IDs.

methods.name: getJobCategoryArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job categories for use in dropdowns or other UI elements.
